# LinkedIn Answer Today

> Daily answers, hints, and explanations for every LinkedIn game: Pinpoint, Crossclimb, Zip, Queens, Tango, Patches, and Mini Sudoku. Answers are updated every day as soon as new puzzles go live on linkedin.com/games.

## Today's Answers

- [All LinkedIn Game Answers Today](https://linkedinanswer.today/today): Answers for all seven LinkedIn games for today's date, updated daily.

## Game Answers & Archives

- [LinkedIn Pinpoint answers](https://linkedinanswer.today/games/pinpoint): Today's Pinpoint answer plus full archive of past answers and clue explanations.
- [LinkedIn Crossclimb answers](https://linkedinanswer.today/games/crossclimb): Today's Crossclimb word-ladder answer plus archives.
- [LinkedIn Zip answers](https://linkedinanswer.today/games/zip): Today's Zip path puzzle answer plus archives.
- [LinkedIn Queens answers](https://linkedinanswer.today/games/queens): Today's Queens grid answer plus archives.
- [LinkedIn Tango answers](https://linkedinanswer.today/games/tango): Today's Tango answer chain plus archives.
- [LinkedIn Patches answers](https://linkedinanswer.today/games/patches): Today's Patches quilt answer plus archives.
- [LinkedIn Mini Sudoku answers](https://linkedinanswer.today/games/mini-sudoku): Today's Mini Sudoku solution grid plus archives.
